Subject: MAP draft: procurement runway & milestone owners

Thanks for the time this morning — quick recap and draft MAP attached. High level asks: confirm target signature date, who owns PO creation in your procurement org, and whether legal needs a formal SOW redline step.

Proposed target close: 2027-11-30 (signature executed)
Key milestones (proposed):
- 11/10: Internal technical review (NovusAI) — owner: Daniel Brooks
- 11/16: Procurement checklist & pricing review — owner: Priya Shah
- 11/22: Legal redline & compliance review — owner: Novus Legal / CC: procurement@novusai.com
- 11/28: Final PO & signoff — owner: Novus Procurement
- 11/30: Contract signature (Redwood + NovusAI) — owner: Exec + Procurement

Dependencies: SOC2 report review, DPA confirmation, and SOW redlines completed.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_NovusAI_v2.xlsx, SOW_v1.pdf

As next steps: if those milestone owners look right, can we lock a procurement-signature target by EOD Friday? If Nov 30 is aggressive for legal, say so and we’ll propose a fallback.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee

soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, Soojin — good summary. Quick notes from our side:
- Procurement will want a full cost breakdown and the proposed billing cadence before we sign. That sits with me but I’ll need finance sign-off.
- Legal has one outstanding data-processing question (DPA scope for Dev environment) — I don’t think we can finalize SOW until that is clarified.
- Realistically, Nov 30 is possible but tight; I need to check with Procurement and Legal.

I’m attaching our standard procurement checklist for reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept our PO terms (net 60) or we should route through our purchasing portal? procurement@novusai.com is looping in the procurement mailbox for visibility.

Thanks for the loop, everyone. Quick legal note after reviewing SOW_v1.pdf:
- We need to align the DPA scope for Dev/test environments; Novus' proposed clause as-is will need a small update to meet our standard controls.
- Typical redline turnaround from our side is 3 business days once we have the specific DPA language requested. If Novus provides the preferred DPA text, we can expedite.
- To preserve a clean approval path I recommend setting the signature target to 2027-12-07 to accommodate internal approvals and any vendor security checklist items.

I’ve attached a one-page redline summary (redlines_SOW_v1.docx) with the key clauses that will be touched. If procurement can confirm PO timing (portal vs PDF) I’ll annotate final steps accordingly.

Regards,
Dev Patel
